headline: RBI to hold second ₹50,000 crore overnight VRR auction on November 25, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct a second Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.
who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants managing short-term liquidity, and treasury teams tracking money-market conditions.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 11:45 AM to 12:15 PM window as per the January 2022 operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI to conduct a second overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility.

Key details:

• Date: Wednesday, November 25, 2026
• Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
• Tenor: 1 day, with reversal on November 26, 2026 (Thursday)
• Window: 11:45 AM to 12:15 PM

The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as those in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For treasury and finance teams, this is a signal to watch short-term liquidity and money-market rates closely.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1559) before acting.
